title: 断层阶城
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is an art-direction seed. Create an original full-bleed wide landscape production concept for a lavish abandoned Gothic magical town stranded among different hours. Design the actual walkable city in depth. Exquisite engraved stone tracery, dense tiny buildings, a legible route, weathered arcades, midnight indigo vs apricot-peach daylight, prismatic slender sky membranes with star fields sewn into cloud banks, thin gold glints. Museum-quality romantic architectural capriccio in painterly cinematic realism, luminous color, meticulous chiaroscuro with legible shaded masonry. There are no people, text, labels, panels, UI or watermarks. Show the whole distinct layout in one atmospheric three-quarter aerial perspective, the foreground closest street large enough to read.
A terraced gorge city: monumental asymmetric twin open belfries, a tilted bronze clock on west terrace high left, a rose-window observatory above east terrace on the right, a sunken narrow market winding through the deep central ravine towards a luminous apricot vanishing point. A massive transversal interrupted Gothic aqueduct, a shorter walkable bridge below it, and flights of stone steps joining three heights. Floating displaced halves of one arcade hover above the valley with visible severed masonry. Bird's eye from the south looking north. Emphasise changes of height and gentle zigzag alleys, the horizon and absurd overlapping crescents beneath a segmented sky.

An impossible longitudinal town where three versions of the SAME magical shopping street overlap at different heights in three parallel time layers. Upper lane in silver moonlight with voids in buildings, ordinary middle lane in rose dusk still retains its chained shop signs, lower excavated lane in amber sunrise among waterlogged ruined foundations. Crumbling transverse stair towers hinge the offset streets together. A distant shattered clock basilica punctuates the far north street axis; many risky cantilevered streets and suspended roof fragments. Seen at a high oblique angle across all three strata; the stacking and strange parallax dominate the composition, very different from a circular town or a plain terraced hill.
